MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pb:Project) MATCH (a)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pa:Project) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL AND pa<>pb
WITH pa.projectKey AS p, collect(DISTINCT a.issueKey)+collect(DISTINCT b.issueKey) AS x, r
RETURN p, r.linkId AS l, x LIMIT 1

MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL
MATCH (a)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pa), (b)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pb) WHERE pa<>pb
UNWIND [[a,pa],[b,pb]] AS e
WITH e[1].projectKey AS id, count(DISTINCT e[0].issueKey) AS value
ORDER BY value DESC
WITH collect({id:id,value:value}) AS L
WITH L, L[4].value AS c
UNWIND L AS x WITH x WHERE x.value>=c
RETURN x.id AS id, x.value AS value

MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL
MATCH (a)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pa), (b)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pb) WHERE pa<>pb AND (pa.projectKey IN ['FE','CRUC','JRASERVER','CWD','BAM'] OR pb.projectKey IN ['FE','CRUC','JRASERVER','CWD','BAM'])
UNWIND [[a,pa],[b,pb]] AS e
WITH e, r WHERE e[1].projectKey IN ['FE','CRUC','JRASERVER','CWD','BAM']
RETURN DISTINCT e[0].issueKey AS issue, r.linkId AS link, e[1].projectKey AS project
UNION
MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL
MATCH (a)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pa), (b)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pb) WHERE pa<>pb AND (pa.projectKey IN ['FE','CRUC','JRASERVER','CWD','BAM'] OR pb.projectKey IN ['FE','CRUC','JRASERVER','CWD','BAM'])
UNWIND [[a,pa,b],[b,pb,a]] AS e
WITH e, r WHERE e[1].projectKey IN ['FE','CRUC','JRASERVER','CWD','BAM']
RETURN DISTINCT e[2].issueKey AS issue, r.linkId AS link, e[1].projectKey AS project
